verdict.rationale: Penpot documents a first-party MCP server so that an external AI agent can be prompted to create and edit design artifacts in Penpot files ('prompt away', 'generating editable design structures'). Prompt-driven design is therefore possible, but only through a bring-your-own agent or LLM, not a native in-app generator. Missing for 10: a native in-product prompt-to-design feature, documented examples of first drafts, layouts or full mockups being produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away!
AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
Penpot enables plenty of AI workflows, from generating editable design structures to connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation.
